caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical white cup with a slightly wider rim and a narrow base, both accented with gold bands. The cup features a central image of a pair of black boots with brown soles, positioned side by side, and facing to the right. Above the boots, an inscription in ornate gold Gothic-style lettering reads "Joseph A. Wagon." Surrounding the boots are two gold decorative branches with leaves, curving upwards on either side of the image. The cup is set against a plain, beige background with no additional objects or decorative elements. The artist’s signature, "Roberta Spicer," is written lightly in the lower left corner.
title: Shaving Mug
